title: Parenting Children with ADHD
learningGoal: Teach parents strategies to support children with ADHD using structure, predictability, and positive reinforcement.
microLesson: Children with ADHD often struggle with attention, impulsivity, and emotional regulation. Predictable routines, visual schedules, and clear expectations help them succeed. Positive reinforcement is more effective than punishment.
activity: Create a simple visual schedule for one part of the day. Reflect on how your child responded.
